kb.title: How to check Bluetooth® LE feature support on wireless STM32 MCUs
kb.content_text:
## 1. Question

You may often see Bluetooth® LE devices marketed as supporting a certain version of Bluetooth. For example, you may see some of the following text in the marketing material for these devices:

* Supports Bluetooth v6.0

* Qualified against Bluetooth Core 6.2

* Bluetooth 5.4 compatible

This may lead you to believe that this device supports all the Bluetooth features released in the stated version + previous versions of Bluetooth. For instance, if a device states support for Bluetooth v5.0, does this mean that it supports the Bluetooth feature known as LE Coded PHY, which was released in this version of the Bluetooth Core specification?

## 2. Answer

The vast majority of Bluetooth features released are optional for device manufacturers to implement. A device that states support for a certain version of Bluetooth does not guarantee support for all Bluetooth features released in that or previous versions.

For this reason, the Bluetooth SIG has released updated [communication guidelines](https://www.bluetooth.com/communicating-supported-bluetooth-functionality/) requiring that Bluetooth devices list the Bluetooth features that are supported instead of just the Bluetooth version. This [blog post](https://www.bluetooth.com/blog/why-it-is-important-to-standardize-communication-for-bluetooth-functionality/) from the Bluetooth SIG discusses the importance of standardizing the communication of Bluetooth functionality.

## 3. Recommendation

We always recommend checking the datasheet, which lists all supported Bluetooth features following the Bluetooth SIG’s guidelines. This applies, for example, to the [STM32WB0](https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32wb0-series.html), [STM32WB](https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32wb-series.html), or [STM32WBA.](https://www.st.com/en/microcontrollers-microprocessors/stm32wba-series.html)

Below is an example from [DS15003](https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/stm32wba25ce.pdf), which is the datasheet for the STM32WBA2.
